sources.original: Zhouyi 周易, text from zh.wikisource.org (public domain); see also ctext.org/book-of-changes
sources.legge: James Legge, The Yi King, Sacred Books of the East vol. XVI (1882), via en.wikisource.org (public domain); hexagrams 1-32 as transcribed there

original_text.image: 天行健，君子以自強不息。

lines.2: 見龍在田，利見大人。
lines.3: 君子終日乾乾，夕惕若；厲，无咎。
lines.4: 或躍在淵，无咎。
lines.5: 飛龍在天，利見大人。
lines.6: 亢龍，有悔。

original_text.tuan: 大哉乾元，萬物資始，乃統天。雲行雨施，品物流形，大明終始，六位時成。時乘六龍以御天，乾道變化，各正性命，保合大和，乃利貞。首出庶物，萬國咸寧。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trời vận hành mạnh mẽ không ngừng, người quân tử tự cường không nghỉ; sức sáng tạo lớn, hanh thông khi giữ chính bền.
interpretation.modern_summary: Năng lượng đang dồi dào: chủ động và kiên trì, nhưng đừng tự mãn — rồng bay quá cao thì có hối.

legge.judgment: Khien (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and firm.

lines.1: In the first (or lowest) line, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon lying hid (in the deep). It is not the time for active doing.
lines.2: In the second line, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon appearing in the field. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.
lines.3: In the third line, undivided, (we see its subject as) the superior man active and vigilant all the day, and in the evening still careful and apprehensive. (The position is) dangerous, but there will be no mistake.
lines.4: In the fourth line, undivided, (we see its subject as the dragon looking) as if he were leaping up, but still in the deep. There will be no mistake.
lines.5: In the fifth line, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon on the wing in the sky. It will be advantageous to meet with the great man.
lines.6: In the sixth (or topmost) line, undivided, (we see its subject as) the dragon exceeding the proper limits. There will be occasion for repentance.

legge.use_all: (The lines of this hexagram are all strong and undivided, as appears from) the use of the number nine. If the host of dragons (thus) appearing were to divest themselves of their heads, there would be good fortune.

original_text.image: 地勢坤，君子以厚德載物。

lines.2: 直方大，不習无不利。
lines.3: 含章，可貞。或從王事，无成有終。
lines.4: 括囊，无咎无譽。
lines.5: 黃裳，元吉。
lines.6: 龍戰于野，其血玄黃。

original_text.tuan: 至哉坤元，萬物資生，乃順承天。坤厚載物，德合无疆；含弘光大，品物咸亨。牝馬地類，行地无疆，柔順利貞。君子攸行，先迷失道，後順得常。西南得朋，乃與類行，東北喪朋，乃終有慶。安貞之吉，應地无疆。
image_lines: 履霜堅冰，陰始凝也。馴致其道，至堅冰也。
六二之動，直以方也。不習无不利，地道光也。
含章可貞，以時發也。或從王事，知光大也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đất dày chở muôn vật; đi sau mà không tranh trước thì được, đức nhu thuận và bền bỉ như ngựa cái.
interpretation.modern_summary: Lúc này hợp với lắng nghe, nâng đỡ và kiên nhẫn hơn là dẫn đầu; sự mềm mỏng bền bỉ có sức mạnh riêng.

legge.judgment: Khwăn (represents) what is great and originating, penetrating, advantageous, correct and having the firmness of a mare. When the superior man (here intended) has to make any movement, if he take the initiative, he will go astray; if he follow, he will find his (proper) lord. The advantageousness will be seen in his getting friends in the south-west, and losing friends in the north-east. If he rest in correctness and firmness, there will be good fortune.

lines.1: In the first line, divided, (we see its subject) treading on hoarfrost. The strong ice will come (by and by).
lines.2: The second line, divided, (shows the attribute of) being straight, square, and great. (Its operation), without repeated efforts, will be in every respect advantageous.
lines.3: The third line, divided, (shows its subject) keeping his excellence under restraint, but firmly maintaining it. If he should have occasion to engage in the king's service, though he will not claim the success (for himself), he will bring affairs to a good issue.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, (shows the symbol of) a sack tied up. There will be no ground for blame or for praise.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, (shows) the yellow lower garment. There will be great good fortune.
lines.6: The sixth line, divided, (shows) dragons fighting in the wild. Their blood is purple and yellow.

legge.use_all: (The lines of this hexagram are all weak and divided, as appears from) the use of the number six. If those (who are thus represented) be perpetually correct and firm, advantage will arise.

original_text.judgment: 元亨，利貞。勿用有攸往，利建侯。
original_text.image: 雲雷，屯；君子以經綸。

lines.2: 屯如邅如，乘馬班如，匪寇婚媾，女子貞不字，十年乃字。
lines.3: 即鹿无虞，惟入于林中，君子幾不如舍，往吝。
lines.4: 乘馬班如，求婚媾，往，吉无不利。
lines.5: 屯其膏；小貞吉，大貞凶。
lines.6: 乘馬班如，泣血漣如。

original_text.tuan: 屯，剛柔始交而難生，動乎險中，大亨貞。雷雨之動滿盈，天造草昧，宜建侯而不寧。
image_lines: 雖磐桓，志行正也。以貴下賤，大得民也。
六二之難，乘剛也。十年乃字，反常也。
即鹿无虞，以從禽也。君子舍之，往吝窮也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Mầm non đội đất mà lên, khởi đầu gian nan; chưa nên vội đi xa, nên dựng nền và tìm người giúp.
interpretation.modern_summary: Khởi đầu nào cũng rối; sắp xếp từng việc nhỏ, nhờ trợ giúp, đừng ép mọi thứ xong ngay.

legge.judgment: Kun (indicates that in the case which it presupposes) there will be great progress and success, and the advantage will come from being correct and firm. (But) any movement in advance should not be (lightly) undertaken. There will be advantage in appointing feudal princes.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows the difficulty (its subject has) in advancing. It will be advantageous for him to abide correct and firm; advantageous (also) to be made a feudal ruler.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows (its subject) distressed and obliged to return; (even) the horses of her chariot (also) seem to be retreating. (But) not by a spoiler (is she assailed), but by one who seeks her to be his wife. The young lady maintains her firm correctness, and declines a union. After ten years she will be united, and have children.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one following the deer without (the guidance of) the forester, and only finding himself in the midst of the forest. The superior man, acquainted with the secret risks, thinks it better to give up the chase. If he went forward, he would regret it.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows (its subject as a lady), the horses of whose chariot appear in retreat. She seeks, however, (the help of) him who seeks her to be his wife. Advance will be fortunate; all will turn out advantageously.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows the difficulties in the way of (its subject's) dispensing the rich favours that might be expected from him. With firmness and correctness there will be good fortune in small things; (even) with them in great things there will be evil.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows (its subject) with the horses of his chariot obliged to retreat, and weeping tears of blood in streams.

original_text.judgment: 亨。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我。初筮告，再三瀆，瀆則不告。利貞。
original_text.image: 山下出泉，蒙；君子以果行育德。

lines.1: 發蒙，利用刑人，用說桎梏，以往吝。
lines.2: 包蒙吉，納婦吉，子克家。
lines.3: 勿用取女，見金夫，不有躬，无攸利。
lines.4: 困蒙，吝。
lines.5: 童蒙，吉。
lines.6: 擊蒙，不利為寇，利禦寇。

original_text.tuan: 蒙，山下有險，險而止，蒙。蒙亨，以亨行，時中也。匪我求童蒙，童蒙求我，志應也。初筮告，以剛中也。再三瀆，瀆則不告，瀆蒙也。蒙以養正，聖功也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Non trẻ mờ tối cần được dạy; không phải thầy tìm trò mà trò tìm thầy, hỏi một lần cho thành tâm.
interpretation.modern_summary: Chưa biết là chuyện bình thường. Hỏi đúng người, học có kỷ luật, đừng hỏi đi hỏi lại chỉ để nghe điều mình muốn.

legge.judgment: Măng (indicates that in the case which it presupposes) there will be progress and success. I do not (go and) seek the youthful and inexperienced, but he comes and seeks me. When he shows (the sincerity that marks) the first recourse to divination, I instruct him. If he apply a second and third time, that is troublesome; and I do not instruct the troublesome. There will be advantage in being firm and correct.

lines.1: The first line, divided, (has respect to) the dispelling of ignorance. It will be advantageous to use punishment (for that purpose), and to remove the shackles (from the mind). But going on in that way (of punishment) will give occasion for regret.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, (shows its subject) exercising forbearance with the ignorant, in which there will be good fortune; and admitting (even the goodness of women, which will also be fortunate. (He may be described also as) a son able to (sustain the burden of) his family.
lines.3: The third line, divided, (seems to say) that one should not marry a woman whose emblem it might be, for that, when she sees a man of wealth, she will not keep her person from him, and in no wise will advantage come from her.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, (shows its subject as if) bound in chains of ignorance. There will be occasion for regret.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows its subject as a simple lad without experience. There will be good fortune.
lines.6: In the topmost line, undivided, we see one smiting the ignorant (youth). But no advantage will come from doing him an injury. Advantage would come from warding off injury from him.

original_text.judgment: 有孚，光亨。貞吉，利涉大川。
original_text.image: 雲上於天，需；君子以飲食宴樂。

lines.2: 需于沙，小有言，終吉。
lines.3: 需于泥，致寇至。
lines.4: 需于血，出自穴。
lines.5: 需于酒食，貞吉。
lines.6: 入于穴，有不速之客三人來，敬之終吉。

original_text.tuan: 需，須也，險在前也；剛健而不陷，其義不困窮矣。需，有孚，光亨，貞吉，位乎天位，以正中也。利涉大川，往有功也。
image_lines: 需于郊，不犯難行也。利用恆，无咎，未失常也。
需于沙，衍在中也。雖小有言，以吉終也。
需于泥，災在外也。自我致寇，敬慎不敗也。
不速之客來，敬之終吉。雖不當位，未大失也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Mây lên trời, chờ mưa; có lòng tin thì sáng sủa hanh thông, chờ đúng lúc thì qua được sông lớn.
interpretation.modern_summary: Chưa đến lúc hành động mạnh; nuôi sức, giữ bình tĩnh và tin tưởng, thời cơ sẽ tới.

legge.judgment: Hsü intimates that, with the sincerity which is declared in it, there will be brilliant success. With firmness there will be good fortune; and it will be advantageous to cross the great stream.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject waiting in the distant border. It will be well for him constantly to maintain (the purpose thus shown), in which case there will be no error.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows its subject waiting on the sand (of the mountain stream). He will (suffer) the small (injury of) being spoken (against), but in the end there will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows its subject in the mud (close by the stream). He thereby invites the approach of injury.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows its subject waiting in (the place of) blood. But he will get out of the cavern.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows its subject waiting amidst the appliances of a feast. Through his firmness and correctness there will be good fortune.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows its subject entered into the cavern. (But) there are three guests coming, without being urged, (to his help). If he receive them respectfully, there will be good fortune in the end.

original_text.judgment: 有孚，窒，惕，中吉，終凶。利見大人，不利涉大川。
original_text.image: 天與水違行，訟；君子以作事謀始。

lines.2: 不克訟，歸而逋，其邑人三百戶无眚。
lines.3: 食舊德，貞厲，終吉。或從王事，无成。
lines.4: 不克訟，復即命渝，安貞吉。
lines.5: 訟，元吉。
lines.6: 或錫之鞶帶，終朝三褫之。

original_text.tuan: 訟，上剛下險，險而健，訟。訟，有孚，窒，惕，中吉，剛來而得中也。終凶，訟不可成也。利見大人，尚中正也。不利涉大川，入于淵也。
image_lines: 不永所事，訟不可長也。雖小有言，其辯明也。
不克訟，歸逋竄也。自下訟上，患至掇也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trời và nước đi ngược nhau mà sinh tranh tụng; giữa chừng dừng lại thì tốt, theo đến cùng thì xấu.
interpretation.modern_summary: Có va chạm: tìm người hòa giải, nhượng một bước, đừng cố thắng đến cùng.

legge.judgment: Sung intimates how, though there is sincerity in one's contention, he will yet meet with opposition and obstruction; but if he cherish an apprehensive caution, there will be good fortune, while, if he must prosecute the contention to the (bitter) end, there will be evil. It will be advantageous to see the great man; it will not be advantageous to cross the great stream.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows its subject not perpetuating the matter about which (the contention is). He will suffer the small (injury) of being spoken against, but the end will be fortunate.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows its subject unequal to the contention. If he retire and keep concealed (where) the inhabitants of his city are (only) three hundred families, he will fall into no mistake.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows its subject keeping in the old place assigned for his support, and firmly correct. Perilous as the position is, there will be good fortune in the end. Should he perchance engage in the king's business, he will not (claim the merit of) achievement.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows its subject unequal to the contention. He returns to (the study of Heaven's) ordinances, changes (his wish to contend), and rests in being firm and correct. There will be good fortune.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows its subject contending;—and with great good fortune.
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, shows how its subject may have the leathern belt conferred on him (by the sovereign), and thrice it shall be taken from him in a morning.

original_text.image: 地中有水，師；君子以容民畜衆。

lines.2: 在師中吉，无咎；王三錫命。
lines.3: 師或輿尸，凶。
lines.4: 師左次，无咎。
lines.5: 田有禽，利執言，无咎。長子帥師，弟子輿尸，貞凶。
lines.6: 大君有命，開國承家，小人勿用。

original_text.tuan: 師，眾也。貞，正也。能以眾正，可以王矣。剛中而應，行險而順，以此毒天下，而民從之，吉又何咎矣。
image_lines: 在師中吉，承天寵也。王三錫命，懷萬邦也。
長子帥師，以中行也。弟子輿尸，使不當也。
大君有命，以正功也。小人勿用，必亂邦也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Nước ẩn trong đất như quân ở trong dân; cần người chỉ huy chính đáng và kỷ luật.
interpretation.modern_summary: Việc lớn cần tổ chức, kỷ luật và một người dẫn dắt đáng tin; rõ mục tiêu, rõ vai trò.

legge.judgment: Sze indicates how, in the case which it supposes, with firmness and correctness, and (a leader of) age and experience, there will be good fortune and no error.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows the host going forth according to the rules (for such a movement). If these be not good, there will be evil.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows (the leader) in the midst of the host. There will be good fortune and no error. The king has thrice conveyed to him the orders (of his favour).
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows how the host may, possibly, have many inefficient leaders. There will be evil.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows the host in retreat. There is no error.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows birds in the fields, which it will be advantageous to seize (and destroy). In that case there will be no error. If the oldest son leads the host, and younger men (idly occupy offices assigned to them), however firm and correct he may be, there will be evil.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows the great ruler delivering his charges, (appointing some) to be rulers of states, and others to undertake the headship of clans; but small men should not be employed (in such positions).

original_text.judgment: 吉。原筮元永貞，无咎。不寧方來，後夫凶。
original_text.image: 地上有水，比；先王以建萬國，親諸侯。

lines.1: 有孚，比之，无咎。有孚盈缶，終來有它，吉。
lines.2: 比之自內，貞吉。
lines.3: 比之匪人。
lines.4: 外比之，貞吉。
lines.5: 顯比。王用三敺，失前禽，邑人不誡，吉。
lines.6: 比之无首，凶。

original_text.tuan: 比，吉也。比，輔也，下順從也。原筮，元永貞，无咎，以剛中也。不寧方來，上下應也。後夫凶，其道窮也。
image_lines: 顯比之吉，位正中也。舍逆取順，失前禽也。邑人不誡，上使中也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Nước trên đất, gắn bó gần gũi; tự xét lòng mình rồi đến với nhau, ai đến muộn thì thiệt.
interpretation.modern_summary: Thời của kết nối: chọn người đồng hành chân thành và chủ động tìm đến họ.

legge.judgment: Pî indicates that (under the conditions which it supposes) there is good fortune. But let (the principal party intended in it) re-examine himself, (as if) by divination, whether his virtue be great, unintermitting, and firm. If it be so, there will be no error. Those who have not rest will then come to him; and with those who are (too) late in coming it will be ill.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows its subject seeking by his sincerity to win the attachment of his object. There will be no error. Let (the breast) be full of sincerity as an earthenware vessel is of its contents, and it will in the end bring other advantages.
lines.2: In the second line, divided, we see the movement towards union and attachment proceeding from the inward (mind). With firm correctness there will be good fortune.
lines.3: In the third line, divided, we see its subject seeking for union with such as ought not to be associated with.
lines.4: In the fourth line, divided, we see its subject seeking for union with the one beyond himself. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, affords the most illustrious instance of seeking union and attachment. (We seem to see in it) the king urging his pursuit of the game (only) in three directions, and allowing the escape of all the animals before him, while the people of his towns do not warn one another (to prevent it). There will be good fortune.
lines.6: In the topmost line, divided, we see one seeking union and attachment without having taken the first step (to such an end). There will be evil.

original_text.image: 風行天上，小畜，君子以懿文德。

lines.2: 牽復，吉。
lines.3: 車說輹，夫妻反目。
lines.4: 有孚，血去惕出，无咎。
lines.5: 有孚攣如，富以其鄰。
lines.6: 既雨既處，尚得載，婦貞厲，月幾望，君子征凶。

original_text.tuan: 小畜，柔得位而上下應之，曰小畜。健而巽，剛中而志行，乃亨。密雲不雨，尚往也。自我西郊，施未行也。
image_lines: 既雨既處，德積載也。君子征凶，有所疑也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Gió đi trên trời, mây dày mà chưa mưa; sức nhỏ kiềm giữ cái lớn, tích từng chút một.
interpretation.modern_summary: Tiến triển nhỏ và bị kìm lại đôi chút; trau chuốt chi tiết, tích lũy, chưa phải lúc bứt phá.

legge.judgment: Hsiâo Khû indicates that (under its conditions) there will be progress and success. (We see) dense clouds, but no rain coming from our borders in the west.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject returning and pursuing his own course. What mistake should he fall into? There will be good fortune.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows its subject, by the attraction (of the former line), returning (to the proper course). There will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, suggests the idea of a carriage, the strap beneath which has been removed, or of a husband and wife looking on each other with averted eyes.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity. The danger of bloodshed is thereby averted, and his (ground for) apprehension dismissed. There will be no mistake.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows its subject possessed of sincerity, and drawing others to unite with him. Rich in resources, he employs his neighbours (in the same cause with himself).
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, shows how the rain has fallen, and the (onward progress) is stayed;—(so) must we value the full accumulation of the virtue (represented by the upper trigram). But a wife (exercising restraint), however firm and correct she may be, is in a position of peril, (and like) the moon approaching to the full. If the superior man prosecute his measures (in such circumstances), there will be evil.

original_text.image: 上天下澤，履；君子以辨上下，定民志。

lines.2: 履道坦坦，幽人貞吉。
lines.3: 眇能視，跛能履，履虎尾，咥人，凶。武人為于大君。
lines.4: 履虎尾，愬愬終吉。
lines.5: 夬履，貞厲。
lines.6: 視履考詳，其旋元吉。

original_text.tuan: 履，柔履剛也。說而應乎乾，是以履虎尾，不咥人，亨，利貞。剛中正，履帝位而不疚，光明也。
image_lines: 眇能視，不足以有明也。跛能履，不足以與行也。咥人之凶，位不當也。武人為于大君，志剛也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Giẫm lên đuôi hổ mà hổ không cắn — nhờ lễ độ và cẩn trọng.
interpretation.modern_summary: Bạn đang ở thế nhạy cảm; cư xử khiêm nhã, đúng mực thì đi qua an toàn.

legge.judgment: (Lî suggests the idea of) one treading on the tail of a tiger, which does not bite him. There will be progress and success.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject treading his accustomed path. If he go forward, there will be no error.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows its subject treading the path that is level and easy;—a quiet and solitary man, to whom, if he be firm and correct, there will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows a one-eyed man (who thinks he) can see; a lame man (who thinks he) can walk well; one who treads on the tail of a tiger and is bitten. (All this indicates) ill fortune. We have a (mere) bravo acting the part of a great ruler.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows its subject treading on the tail of a tiger. He becomes full of apprehensive caution, and in the end there will be good fortune.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows the resolute tread of its subject. Though he be firm and correct, there will be peril.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, tells us to look at (the whole course) that is trodden, and examine the presage which that gives. If it be complete and without failure, there will be great good fortune.

original_text.image: 天地交，泰；后以財成天地之道，輔相天地之宜，以左右民。

lines.2: 包荒。用馮河，不遐遺；朋亡。得尚于中行。
lines.3: 无平不陂，无往不復，艱貞无咎。勿恤其孚，于食有福。
lines.4: 翩翩，不富以其鄰；不戒以孚。
lines.5: 帝乙歸妹，以祉，元吉。
lines.6: 城復于隍，勿用師，自邑告命，貞吝。

original_text.tuan: 泰，小往大來，吉亨。則是天地交而萬物通也，上下交而其志同也。內陽而外陰，內健而外順，內君子而外小人，君子道長，小人道消也。
image_lines: 包荒，得尚于中行，以光大也。
翩翩不富，皆失實也。不戒以孚，中心願也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trời đất giao hòa, cái nhỏ đi cái lớn đến; thời thông suốt, cát.
interpretation.modern_summary: Mọi thứ thuận và hài hòa — dùng lúc này để xây dựng, và nhớ rằng thịnh rồi sẽ có lúc suy.

legge.judgment: In Thâi (we see) the little gone and the great come. (It indicates that) there will be good fortune, with progress and success.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, suggests the idea of grass pulled up, and bringing with it other stalks with whose roots it is connected. Advance (on the part of its subject) will be fortunate.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows one who can bear with the uncultivated, will cross the Ho without a boat, does not forget the distant, and has no (selfish) friendships. Thus does he prove himself acting in accordance with the course of the due Mean.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows that, while there is no state of peace that is not liable to be disturbed, and no departure (of evil men) so that they shall not return, yet when one is firm and correct, as he realises the distresses that may arise, he will commit no error. There is no occasion for sadness at the certainty (of such recurring changes); and in this mood the happiness (of the present) may be (long) enjoyed.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows its subject fluttering (down);—not relying on his own rich resources, but calling in his neighbours. (They all come) not as having received warning, but in the sincerity (of their hearts).
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, reminds us of (king) Tî-yî's (rule about the) marriage of his younger sister. By such a course there is happiness and there will be great good fortune.
lines.6: The sixth line, divided, shows us the city wall returned into the moat. It is not the time to use the army. (The subject of the line) may, indeed, announce his orders to the people of his own city; but however correct and firm he may be, he will have cause for regret.

original_text.judgment: 否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。
original_text.image: 天地不交，否；君子以儉德辟難，不可榮以祿。

lines.2: 包承，小人吉，大人否。亨。
lines.3: 包羞。
lines.4: 有命，无咎，疇離祉。
lines.5: 休否，大人吉。其亡其亡，繫于包桑。
lines.6: 傾否，先否後喜。

original_text.tuan: 否之匪人，不利君子貞，大往小來。則是天地不交而萬物不通也，上下不交而天下无邦也。內陰而外陽，內柔而外剛，內小人而外君子，小人道長，君子道消也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trời đất không giao nhau thì bế tắc; người quân tử thu mình giữ đức, tránh danh lợi.
interpretation.modern_summary: Giai đoạn tắc nghẽn: đừng cố đẩy; giữ giá trị của mình, chờ dòng chảy đổi chiều.

legge.judgment: In Phî there is the want of good understanding between the (different classes of) men, and its indication is unfavourable to the firm and correct course of the superior man. We see in it the great gone and the little come.

lines.1: The first line, divided, suggests the idea of grass pulled up, and bringing with it other stalks with whose roots it is connected. With firm correctness (on the part of its subject), there will be good fortune and progress.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows its subject patient and obedient. To the small man (comporting himself so) there will be good fortune. If the great man (comport himself) as the distress and obstruction require, he will have success.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows its subject ashamed of the purpose folded (in his breast).
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows its subject acting in accordance with the ordination (of Heaven), and committing no error. His companions will come and share in his happiness.
lines.5: In the fifth line, undivided, we see him who brings the distress and obstruction to a close,—the great man and fortunate. (But let him say), 'We may perish! We may perish!' (so shall the state of things become firm, as if) bound to a clump of bushy mulberry trees.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows the overthrow (and removal of) the condition of distress and obstruction. Before this there was that condition. Hereafter there will be joy.

original_text.judgment: 同人于野，亨。 利涉大川，利君子貞。
original_text.image: 天與火，同人；君子以類族辨物。

lines.2: 同人于宗，吝。
lines.3: 伏戎于莽，升其高陵，三歲不興。
lines.4: 乘其庸，弗克攻，吉。
lines.5: 同人，先號啕而後笑。大師克相遇。
lines.6: 同人于郊，無悔。

original_text.tuan: 同人，柔得位得中，而應乎乾，曰同人。同人曰，同人于野，亨。利涉大川，乾行也。文明以健，中正而應，君子正也。唯君子為能通天下之志。
image_lines: 伏戎于莽，敵剛也。三歲不興，安行也。
乘其庸，義弗克也，其吉，則困而反則也。
同人之先，以中直也。大師相遇，言相克也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Cùng người ở nơi đồng nội — đoàn kết rộng rãi, công khai thì hanh thông.
interpretation.modern_summary: Tìm điểm chung, làm việc minh bạch với nhóm; sức mạnh đến từ sự đồng lòng chứ không phải phe phái.

legge.judgment: Thung Zăn (or 'Union of men') appears here (as we find it) in the (remote districts of the) country, indicating progress and success. It will be advantageous to cross the great stream. It will be advantageous to maintain the firm correctness of the superior man.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, (shows the representative of) the union of men just issuing from his gate. There will be no error.
lines.2: The second line, divided, (shows the representative of) the union of men in relation with his kindred. There will be occasion for regret.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, (shows its subject) with his arms hidden in the thick grass, and at the top of a high mound. (But) for three years he makes no demonstration.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, (shows its subject) mounted on the city wall; but he does not proceed to make the attack (he contemplates). There will be good fortune.
lines.5: In the fifth line, undivided, (the representative of) the union of men first wails and cries out, and then laughs. His great host conquers, and he (and the subject of the second line) meet together.
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, (shows the representative of) the union of men in the suburbs. There will be no occasion for repentance.

original_text.image: 火在天上，大有；君子以遏惡揚善，順天休命。

lines.2: 大轝以載，有攸往，无咎。
lines.3: 公用亨于天子，小人弗克。
lines.4: 匪其尫，无咎。
lines.5: 厥孚交如，威如；吉。
lines.6: 自天佑之，吉无不利。

original_text.tuan: 大有，柔得尊位，大中而上下應之，曰大有。其德剛健而文明，應乎天而時行，是以元亨。
image_lines: 公用亨于天子，小人害也。
厥孚交如，信以發志也。威如之吉，易而无備也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Lửa trên trời soi khắp, có được nhiều; ngăn điều ác, nêu điều thiện, thuận theo trời.
interpretation.modern_summary: Bạn đang có nhiều nguồn lực; dùng chúng rộng lượng và khiêm tốn thì phúc mới bền.

legge.judgment: Tâ Yû indicates that, (under the circumstances which it implies), there will be great progress and success.

lines.1: In the first line, undivided, there is no approach to what is injurious, and there is no error. Let there be a realisation of the difficulty (and danger of the position), and there will be no error (to the end).
lines.2: In the second line, undivided, we have a large waggon with its load. In whatever direction advance is made, there will be no error.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows us a feudal prince presenting his offerings to the Son of Heaven. A small man would be unequal (to such a duty).
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows its subject keeping his great resources under restraint. There will be no error.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows the sincerity of its subject reciprocated by that of all the others (represented in the hexagram). Let him display a proper majesty, and there will be good fortune.
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, shows its subject with help accorded to him from Heaven. There will be good fortune, advantage in every respect.

original_text.image: 地中有山，謙；君子以裒多益寡，稱物平施。

lines.2: 鳴謙，貞吉。
lines.3: 勞謙君子，有終吉。
lines.4: 无不利，撝謙。
lines.5: 不富，以其鄰，利用侵伐，无不利。
lines.6: 鳴謙，利用行師，征邑國。

original_text.tuan: 謙，亨，天道下濟而光明，地道卑而上行。天道虧盈而益謙，地道變盈而流謙，鬼神害盈而福謙，人道惡盈而好謙。謙尊而光，卑而不可逾，君子之終也。
image_lines: 鳴謙，志未得也。可用行師，征邑國也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Núi ở dưới đất là khiêm; bớt chỗ nhiều bù chỗ ít, người quân tử khiêm thì có kết quả tốt.
interpretation.modern_summary: Khiêm tốn không phải nhỏ bé; làm tốt mà không phô trương sẽ mở nhiều cánh cửa.

legge.judgment: Khien indicates progress and success. The superior man, (being humble as it implies), will have a (good) issue (to his undertakings).

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows us the superior man who adds humility to humility. (Even) the great stream may be crossed with this, and there will be good fortune.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows us humility that has made itself recognised. With firm correctness there will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows the superior man of (acknowledged) merit. He will maintain his success to the end, and have good fortune.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows one, whose action would be in every way advantageous, stirring up (the more) his humility.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows one who, without being rich, is able to employ his neighbours. He may advantageously use the force of arms. All his movements will be advantageous.
lines.6: The sixth line, divided, shows us humility that has made itself recognised. The subject of it will with advantage put his hosts in motion; but (he will only) punish his own towns and state.

original_text.image: 雷出地奮，豫。先王以作樂崇德，殷薦之上帝，以配祖考。

lines.2: 介于石，不終日，貞吉。
lines.3: 盱豫，悔。遲有悔。
lines.4: 由豫，大有得。勿疑。朋盍戠。
lines.5: 貞疾，恆不死。
lines.6: 冥豫，成有渝，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 豫，剛應而志行，順以動，豫。豫，順以動，故天地如之，而況建侯行師乎？天地以順動，故日月不過，而四時不忒；聖人以順動，則刑罰清而民服。豫之時義大矣哉！
image_lines: 六五貞疾，乘剛也。恆不死，中未亡也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm ra khỏi đất, muôn vật vui; thuận theo lòng người mà hành động.
interpretation.modern_summary: Có hứng khởi và động lực — dùng nó để khởi động việc chung, nhưng đừng say mê đến lơ là.

legge.judgment: Yü indicates that, (in the state which it implies), feudal princes may be set up, and the hosts put in motion, with advantage.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows its subject proclaiming his pleasure and satisfaction. There will be evil.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one who is firm as a rock. (He sees a thing) without waiting till it has come to pass; with his firm correctness there will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one looking up (for favours), while he indulges the feeling of pleasure and satisfaction. If he would understand!—If he be late in doing so, there will indeed be occasion for repentance.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows him from whom the harmony and satisfaction come. Great is the success which he obtains. Let him not allow suspicions to enter his mind, and thus friends will gather around him.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows one with a chronic complaint, but who lives on without dying.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows its subject with darkened mind devoted to the pleasure and satisfaction (of the time); but if he change his course even when (it may be considered as) completed, there will be no error.

original_text.image: 澤中有雷，隨；君子以嚮晦入宴息。

lines.1: 官有渝，貞吉。出門交有功。
lines.2: 係小子，失丈夫。
lines.3: 係丈夫，失小子。隨，有求得利，居貞。
lines.4: 隨有獲，貞凶。有孚在道，以明，何咎。
lines.5: 孚于嘉，吉。
lines.6: 拘係之，乃從維之。王用亨于西山。

original_text.tuan: 隨，剛來而下柔，動而說，隨。大亨貞，无咎，而天下隨時，隨時之義大矣哉！
image_lines: 官有渝，從正吉也。出門交有功，不失也。
隨有獲，其義凶也。有孚在道，明功也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Theo đúng đạo thì hanh thông, không lỗi; biết theo thời, chiều tối thì vào nghỉ.
interpretation.modern_summary: Lúc này nên linh hoạt, theo dòng chảy và theo người đáng theo, nhưng giữ nguyên tắc của mình.

legge.judgment: Sui indicates that (under its conditions) there will be great progress and success. But it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. There will (then) be no error.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows us one changing the object of his pursuit; but if he be firm and correct, there will he good fortune. Going beyond (his own) gate to find associates, he will achieve merit.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows us one who cleaves to the little boy, and lets go the man of age and experience.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows us one who cleaves to the man of age and experience, and lets go the little boy. Such following will get what it seeks; but it will be advantageous to adhere to what is firm and correct.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows us one followed and obtaining (adherents). Though he be firm and correct, there will be evil. If he be sincere (however) in his course, and make that evident, into what error will he fall?
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows us (the ruler) sincere in (fostering all) that is excellent. There will be good fortune.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows us (that sincerity) firmly held and clung to, yea, and bound fast. (We see) the king with it presenting his offerings on the western mountain.

original_text.judgment: 元亨。利涉大川。先甲三日，後甲三日。
original_text.image: 山下有風，蠱；君子以振民育德。

lines.1: 幹父之蠱，有子考，无咎，厲終吉。
lines.2: 幹母之蠱，不可貞。
lines.3: 幹父之蠱，小有悔，无大咎。
lines.4: 裕父之蠱，往見吝。
lines.5: 幹父之蠱，用譽。
lines.6: 不事王侯，高尚其事。

original_text.tuan: 蠱，剛上而柔下，巽而止，蠱。蠱，元亨，而天下治也。利涉大川，往有事也。先甲三日，後甲三日，終則有始，天行也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đồ để lâu sinh sâu mọt — phải sửa cái hư nát đời trước để lại; trước ba ngày, sau ba ngày cân nhắc.
interpretation.modern_summary: Có việc cũ bị bỏ bê cần sửa; nhìn thẳng vào nguyên nhân, lên kế hoạch rồi bắt tay làm.

legge.judgment: Kû indicates great progress and success (to him who deals properly with the condition represented by it). There will be advantage in (efforts like that of) crossing the great stream. (He should weigh well, however, the events of) three days before the turning point, and those (to be done) three days after it.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his father. If he be an (able) son, the father will escape the blame of having erred. The position is perilous, but there will be good fortune in the end.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his mother. He should not (carry) his firm correctness (to the utmost).
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his father. There may be some small occasion for repentance, but there will not be any great error.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows (a son) viewing indulgently the troubles caused by his father. If he go forward, he will find cause to regret it.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows (a son) dealing with the troubles caused by his father. He obtains the praise of using (the fit instrument for his work).
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows us one who does not serve either king or feudal lord, but in a lofty spirit prefers (to attend to) his own affairs.

original_text.judgment: 元亨。利貞。至于八月有凶。
original_text.image: 澤上有地，臨；君子以教思无窮，容保民无疆。

lines.2: 咸臨，吉无不利。
lines.3: 甘臨，无攸利。既憂之，无咎。
lines.4: 至臨，无咎。
lines.5: 知臨，大君之宜，吉。
lines.6: 敦臨，吉无咎。

original_text.tuan: 臨，剛浸而長。說而順，剛中而應，大亨以正，天之道也。至于八月有凶，消不久也。
image_lines: 咸臨，吉无不利；未順命也。
甘臨，位不當也。既憂之，咎不長也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đất ở trên đầm, đến gần mà chăm nom; lớn mạnh hanh thông, nhưng đến tháng tám thì có hung.
interpretation.modern_summary: Thời thế đang đến gần và thuận; hãy tận tâm, và chuẩn bị cho lúc chu kỳ đổi chiều.

legge.judgment: Lin (indicates that under the conditions supposed in it) there will be great progress and success, while it will be advantageous to be firmly correct. In the eighth month there will be evil.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject advancing in company (with the subject of the second line). Through his firm correctness there will be good fortune.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows its subject advancing in company (with the subject of the first line). There will be good fortune; (advancing) will be in every way advantageous.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one well pleased (indeed) to advance, (but whose action) will be in no way advantageous. If he become anxious about it (however), there will be no error.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows one advancing in the highest mode. There will be no error.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows the advance of wisdom, such as befits the great ruler. There will be good fortune.
lines.6: The sixth line, divided, shows the advance of honesty and generosity. There will be good fortune, and no error.

original_text.image: 風行地上，觀；先王以省方，觀民設教。

lines.2: 窺觀，利女貞。
lines.3: 觀我生，進退。
lines.4: 觀國之光，利用賓于王。
lines.5: 觀我生，君子无咎。
lines.6: 觀其生，君子无咎。

original_text.tuan: 大觀在上，順而巽，中正以觀天下。觀，盥而不薦，有孚顒若，下觀而化也。觀天之神道，而四時不忒，聖人以神道設教，而天下服矣。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Gió đi trên đất — quan sát và được trông vào; như người tế lễ đã rửa tay mà chưa dâng, đầy thành kính.
interpretation.modern_summary: Dừng lại để nhìn toàn cảnh và tự xét mình; cách bạn sống chính là tấm gương người khác nhìn vào.

legge.judgment: Kwân shows (how he whom it represents should be like) the worshipper who has washed his hands, but not (yet) presented his offerings;—with sincerity and an appearance of dignity (commanding reverent regard).

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows the looking of a lad;—not blamable in men of inferior rank, but matter for regret in superior men.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one peeping out from a door. It would be advantageous if it were (merely) the firm correctness of a female.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one looking at (the course of) his own life, to advance or recede (accordingly).
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows one contemplating the glory of the kingdom. It will be advantageous for him, being such as he is, (to seek) to be a guest of the king.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows its subject contemplating his own life(-course). A superior man, he will (thus) fall into no error.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows its subject contemplating his character to see if it be indeed that of a superior man. He will not fall into error.

original_text.image: 雷電噬嗑；先王以明罰敕法。

lines.2: 噬膚滅鼻，无咎。
lines.3: 噬昔肉，遇毒；小吝，无咎。
lines.4: 噬乾胏，得金矢，利艱貞，吉。
lines.5: 噬乾肉，得黃金，貞厲，无咎。
lines.6: 何校滅耳，凶。

original_text.tuan: 頤中有物，曰噬嗑，噬嗑而亨。剛柔分，動而明，雷電合而章。柔得中而上行，雖不當位，利用獄也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Có vật chắn giữa hàm thì phải cắn đứt; lợi về dùng hình luật, rõ ràng như sấm chớp.
interpretation.modern_summary: Có chướng ngại cụ thể đang cản: gọi đúng tên nó và xử lý dứt khoát, công bằng.

legge.judgment: Shih Ho indicates successful progress (in the condition of things which it supposes). It will be advantageous to use legal constraints.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows one with his feet in the stocks and deprived of his toes. There will be no error.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one biting through the soft flesh, and (going on to) bite off the nose. There will be no error.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one gnawing dried flesh, and meeting with what is disagreeable. There will be occasion for some small regret, but no (great) error.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows one gnawing the flesh dried on the bone, and getting the pledges of money and arrows. It will be advantageous to him to realise the difficulty of his task and be firm,—in which case there will be good fortune.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows one gnawing at dried flesh, and finding the yellow gold. Let him be firm and correct, realising the peril (of his position). There will be no error.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows one wearing the cangue, and deprived of his ears. There will be evil.

original_text.image: 山下有火，賁；君子以明庶政，无敢折獄。

lines.2: 賁其須。
lines.3: 賁如濡如，永貞吉。
lines.4: 賁如皤如，白馬翰如，匪寇婚媾。
lines.5: 賁於丘園，束帛戔戔，吝，終吉。
lines.6: 白賁，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 賁，亨；柔來而文剛，故亨。分剛上而文柔，故小利有攸往。剛柔交錯，天文也；文明以止，人文也。觀乎天文，以察時變；觀乎人文，以化成天下。
image_lines: 六四，當位疑也。匪寇婚媾，終无尤也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Lửa dưới núi là vẻ trang sức; việc nhỏ thì lợi, không dựa vào bề ngoài để quyết việc lớn.
interpretation.modern_summary: Hình thức đẹp có giá trị, nhưng đừng để nó thay cho thực chất.

legge.judgment: Pî indicates that there should be free course (in what it denotes). There will be little advantage (however) if it be allowed to advance (and take the lead).

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows one adorning (the way of) his feet. He can discard a carriage and walk on foot.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one adorning his beard.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows its subject with the appearance of being adorned and bedewed (with rich favours). But let him ever maintain his firm correctness, and there will be good fortune.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows one looking as if adorned, but only in white. As if (mounted on) a white horse, and furnished with wings, (he seeks union with the subject of the first line), while (the intervening third pursues), not as a robber, but intent on a matrimonial alliance.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows its subject adorned by (the occupants of) the heights and gardens. He bears his roll of silk, small and slight. He may appear stingy; but there will be good fortune in the end.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows one with white as his (only) ornament. There will be no error.

original_text.image: 山附地上，剝；上以厚下，安宅。

lines.2: 剝牀以辨，蔑貞凶。
lines.3: 剝之，无咎。
lines.4: 剝牀以膚，凶。
lines.5: 貫魚，以宮人寵，无不利。
lines.6: 碩果不食，君子德車，小人剝廬。

original_text.tuan: 剝，剝也，柔變剛也。不利有攸往，小人長也。順而止之，觀象也。君子尚消息盈虛，天行也。
image_lines: 君子得輿，民所載也。小人剝廬，終不可用也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Núi tựa trên đất mà bị bào mòn; âm lấn dương, không lợi có chỗ đi.
interpretation.modern_summary: Điều gì đó đang mòn dần; đừng hành động liều, giữ nền tảng và để chu kỳ tự đổi.

legge.judgment: Po indicates that (in the state which it symbolises) it will not be advantageous to make a movement in any direction whatever.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows one overturning the couch by injuring its legs. (The injury will go on to) the destruction of (all) firm correctness, and there will be evil.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one overthrowing the couch by injuring its frame. (The injury will go on to) the destruction of (all) firm correctness, and there will be evil.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows its subject among the overthrowers; but there will be no error.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows its subject having overthrown the couch, and (going to injure) the skin (of him who lies on it). There will be evil.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows (its subject leading on the others like) a string of fishes, and (obtaining for them) the favour that lights on the inmates of the palace. There will be advantage in every way.
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, shows its subject (as) a great fruit which has not been eaten. The superior man finds (the people again) as a chariot carrying him. The small men (by their course) overthrow their own dwellings.

original_text.judgment: 亨。出入无疾，朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復，利有攸往。
original_text.image: 雷在地中，復；先王以至日閉關，商旅不行，后不省方。

lines.2: 休復，吉。
lines.3: 頻復，厲无咎。
lines.4: 中行獨復。
lines.5: 敦復，无悔。
lines.6: 迷復，凶，有災眚。用行師，終有大敗，以其國君，凶；至于十年，不克征。

original_text.tuan: 復亨；剛反，動而以順行，是以出入无疾，朋來无咎。反復其道，七日來復，天行也。利有攸往，剛長也。復其見天地之心乎？

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm trong lòng đất — một hào dương trở lại; bảy ngày thì quay về, ra vào không bệnh.
interpretation.modern_summary: Điểm chuyển mình: điều tốt bắt đầu quay lại; đi chậm và nuôi dưỡng nó từ từ.

legge.judgment: Fû indicates that there will be free course and progress (in what it denotes). (The subject of it) finds no one to distress him in his exits and entrances; friends come to him, and no error is committed. He will return and repeat his (proper) course. In seven days comes his return. There will be advantage in whatever direction movement is made.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject returning (from an error) of no great extent, which would not proceed to anything requiring repentance. There will be great good fortune.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows the admirable return (of its subject). There will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one who has made repeated returns. The position is perilous, but there will be no error.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows its subject moving right in the centre (among those represented by the other divided lines), and yet returning alone (to his proper path).
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows the noble return of its subject. There will be no ground for repentance.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows its subject all astray on the subject of returning. There will be evil. There will be calamities and errors. If with his views he put the hosts in motion, the end will be a great defeat, whose issues will extend to the ruler of the state. Even in ten years he will not be able to repair the disaster.

original_text.judgment: 元亨。利貞。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。
original_text.image: 天下雷行，物與无妄；先王以茂對時，育萬物。

lines.2: 不耕穫，不菑畬，則利有攸往。
lines.3: 无妄之災，或繫之牛，行人之得，邑人之災。
lines.4: 可貞，无咎。
lines.5: 无妄之疾，勿藥有喜。
lines.6: 无妄，行有眚，无攸利。

original_text.tuan: 无妄，剛自外來，而為主於內。動而健，剛中而應，大亨以正，天之命也。其匪正有眚，不利有攸往。无妄之往，何之矣？ 天命不佑，行矣哉？

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm đi dưới trời, không càn bậy; giữ lòng chân thật thì hanh thông, không chính thì có tai họa.
interpretation.modern_summary: Hành động tự nhiên, ngay thẳng, không toan tính; điều bất ngờ có thể đến, đừng cưỡng cầu.

legge.judgment: Wû Wang indicates great progress and success, while there will be advantage in being firm and correct. If (its subject and his action) be not correct, he will fall into errors, and it will not be advantageous for him to move in any direction.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject free from all insincerity. His advance will be accompanied with good fortune.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one who reaps without having ploughed (that he might reap), and gathers the produce of his third year's fields without having cultivated them the first year for that end. To such a one there will be advantage in whatever direction he may move.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows calamity happening to one who is free from insincerity;—as in the case of an ox that has been tied up. A passer by finds it (and carries it off), while the people in the neighbourhood have the calamity (of being accused and apprehended).
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows (a case) in which, if its subject can remain firm and correct, there will be no error.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows one who is free from insincerity, and yet has fallen ill. Let him not use medicine, and he will have occasion for joy (in his recovery).
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, shows its subject free from insincerity, yet sure to fall into error, if he take action. (His action) will not be advantageous in any way.

original_text.judgment: 利貞，不家食吉，利涉大川。
original_text.image: 天在山中，大畜；君子以多識前言往行，以畜其德。

lines.2: 輿說輹。
lines.3: 良馬逐，利艱貞，吉。日閑輿衛，利有攸往。
lines.4: 童牛之告，元吉。
lines.5: 豶豕之牙，吉。
lines.6: 何天之衢，亨。

original_text.tuan: 大畜，剛健篤實輝光，日新其德，剛上而尚賢。能止健，大正也。不家食吉，養賢也。利涉大川，應乎天也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trời ở trong núi — tích chứa lớn; học lời hay việc tốt của người xưa để nuôi đức.
interpretation.modern_summary: Tích lũy sức và hiểu biết; tự kiềm chế đúng lúc sẽ cho bạn đủ lực để làm việc lớn.

legge.judgment: Under the conditions of Tâ Khû it will be advantageous to be firm and correct. (If its subject do not seek to) enjoy his revenues in his own family (without taking service at court), there will be good fortune. It will be advantageous for him to cross the great stream.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows its subject in a position of peril. It will be advantageous for him to stop his advance.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows a carriage with the strap under it removed.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows its subject urging his way with good horses. It will be advantageous for him to realise the difficulty (of his course), and to be firm and correct, exercising himself daily in his charioteering and methods of defence; then there will be advantage in whatever direction he may advance.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows the young bull, (and yet) having the piece of wood over his horns. There will be great good fortune.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows the teeth of a castrated hog. There will be good fortune.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows its subject (as) in command of the firmament of heaven. There will be progress.

original_text.image: 山下有雷，頤；君子以慎言語，節飲食。

lines.2: 顛頤，拂經，于丘頤，征凶。
lines.3: 拂頤，貞凶，十年勿用，无攸利。
lines.4: 顛頤吉，虎視眈眈，其欲逐逐，无咎。
lines.5: 拂經，居貞吉，不可涉大川。
lines.6: 由頤，厲吉，利涉大川。

original_text.tuan: 頤貞吉，養正則吉也。觀頤，觀其所養也；自求口實，觀其自養也。天地養萬物，聖人養賢，以及萬民；頤之時大矣哉！

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Dưới núi có sấm, hình cái miệng nuôi dưỡng; xem người nuôi gì và tự tìm cái nuôi mình.
interpretation.modern_summary: Để ý điều bạn nạp vào — đồ ăn, lời nói, thông tin — và điều bạn nuôi dưỡng ở người khác.

legge.judgment: Î indicates that with firm correctness there will be good fortune (in what is denoted by it). We must look at what we are seeking to nourish, and by the exercise of our thoughts seek for the proper aliment.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, (seems to be thus addressed), 'You leave your efficacious tortoise, and look at me till your lower jaw hangs down.' There will be evil.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one looking downwards for nourishment, which is contrary to what is proper; or seeking it from the height (above), advance towards which will lead to evil.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows one acting contrary to the method of nourishing. However firm he may be, there will be evil. For ten years let him not take any action, (for) it will not be in any way advantageous.
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows one looking downwards for (the power to) nourish. There will be good fortune. Looking with a tiger's downward unwavering glare, and with his desire that impels him to spring after spring, he will fall into no error.
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows one acting contrary to what is regular and proper; but if he abide in firmness, there will be good fortune. He should not, (however, try to) cross the great stream.
lines.6: The sixth line, undivided, shows him from whom comes the nourishing. His position is perilous, but there will be good fortune. It will be advantageous to cross the great stream.

original_text.image: 澤滅木，大過。君子以獨立不懼，遯世无悶。

lines.2: 枯楊生稊，老夫得其女妻，无不利。
lines.3: 棟橈，凶。
lines.4: 棟隆，吉。有它吝。
lines.5: 枯楊生華，老婦得其士夫，无咎无譽。
lines.6: 過涉滅頂，凶，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 大過，大者過也。棟橈，本末弱也。剛過而中，巽而說行，利有攸往，乃亨。大過之時大矣哉！
image_lines: 棟橈之凶，不可以有輔也。
枯楊生華，何可久也。老婦士夫，亦可醜也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đầm ngập cây, cây xà cong oằn; quá mức nhưng có chỗ đi thì hanh thông.
interpretation.modern_summary: Gánh nặng đang quá sức; cần điều chỉnh mạnh, dám đứng một mình nếu cần, nhưng đừng để gãy.

legge.judgment: Tâ Kwo suggests to us a beam that is weak. There will be advantage in moving (under its conditions) in any direction whatever; there will be success.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows one placing mats of the white mâo grass under things set on the ground. There will be no error.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows a decayed willow producing shoots, or an old husband in possession of his young wife. There will be advantage in every way.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows a beam that is weak. There will be evil.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows a beam curving upwards. There will be good fortune. If (the subject of it) looks for other (help but that of line one), there will be cause for regret.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows a decayed willow producing flowers, or an old wife in possession of her young husband. There will be occasion neither for blame nor for praise.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows its subject with extraordinary (boldness) wading through a stream, till the water hides the crown of his head. There will be evil, but no ground for blame.

original_text.judgment: 習坎：有孚，維心亨。行有尚。
original_text.image: 水洊至，習坎；君子以常德行，習教事。

lines.2: 坎有險，求小得。
lines.3: 來之坎坎，險且枕，入于坎窞，勿用。
lines.4: 尊酒簋，貳用缶。内約自牖，終无咎。
lines.5: 坎不盈，禔既平，无咎。
lines.6: 係用徽纆，寘于叢棘，三歲不得，凶。

original_text.tuan: 習坎，重險也。水流而不盈，行險而不失其信。維心亨，乃以剛中也。行有尚，往有功也。天險不可升也，地險山川丘陵也，王公設險以守其國，坎之時用大矣哉！

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Nước chảy liên tục qua chỗ hiểm; có lòng tin, giữ tâm hanh thông thì việc làm được quý.
interpretation.modern_summary: Đang ở chỗ khó lặp lại; như nước, cứ kiên trì chảy và giữ thật lòng, sẽ qua.

legge.judgment: Khan, here repeated, shows the possession of sincerity, through which the mind is. penetrating. Action (in accordance with this) will be of high value.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows its subject in the double defile, and (yet) entering a cavern within it. There will be evil.
lines.2: The second line, undivided, shows its subject in all the peril of the defile. He will, however, get a little (of the deliverance) that he seeks.
lines.3: The third line, divided, shows its subject, whether he comes or goes (=descends or ascends), confronted by a defile. All is peril to him and unrest. (His endeavours) will lead him into the cavern of the pit. There should be no action (in such a case).
lines.4: The fourth line, divided, shows its subject (at a feast), with (simply) a bottle of spirits, and a subsidiary basket of rice, while (the cups and bowls) are (only) of earthenware. He introduces his important lessons (as his ruler's) intelligence admits. There will in the end be no error.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows the water of the defile not yet full, (so that it might flow away); but order will (soon) be brought about. There will be no error.
lines.6: The topmost line, divided, shows its subject bound with cords of three strands or two strands, and placed in the thicket of thorns. But in three years he does not learn the course for him to pursue. There will be evil.

original_text.image: 明兩作離，大人以繼明照于四方。

lines.2: 黃離，元吉。
lines.3: 日昃之離，不鼓缶而歌，則大耋之差，凶。
lines.4: 突如其來如，焚如，死如，棄如。
lines.5: 出涕沱若，戚嗟若，吉。
lines.6: 王用出征，有嘉折首，獲匪其醜，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 離，麗也；日月麗乎天，百穀草木麗乎土，重明以麗乎正，乃化成天下。柔麗乎中正，故亨；是以畜牝牛吉也。

interpretation.core_theme: Clarity that clings to what is right
interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sáng nối sáng; bám vào chính đạo thì sáng, nuôi đức thuận như bò cái thì tốt.
interpretation.modern_summary: Sự rõ ràng đến từ việc bám vào điều đúng; giữ ngọn lửa của mình mà không đốt cháy người khác.

legge.judgment: Lî indicates that, (in regard to what it denotes), it will be advantageous to be firm and correct, and that thus there will be free course and success. Let (its subject) also nourish (a docility like that of) the cow, and there will be good fortune.

lines.1: The first line, undivided, shows one ready to move with confused steps. But he treads at the same time reverently, and there will be no mistake.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows its subject in his place in yellow. There will be great good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows its subject in a position like that of the declining sun. Instead of playing on his instrument of earthenware, and singing to it, he utters the groans of an old man of eighty. There will be evil.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows the manner of its subject's coming. How abrupt it is, as with fire, with death, to be rejected (by all)!
lines.5: The fifth line, divided, shows its subject as one with tears flowing in torrents, and groaning in sorrow. There will be good fortune.
lines.6: The topmost line, undivided, shows the king employing its subject in his punitive expeditions. Achieving admirable (merit), he breaks (only) the chiefs (of the rebels). Where his prisoners were not their associates, he does not punish. There will be no error.

original_text.image: 山上有澤，咸；君子以虛受人。

lines.2: 咸其腓，凶，居吉。
lines.3: 咸其股，執其隨，往吝。
lines.4: 貞吉悔亡，憧憧往來，朋從爾思。
lines.5: 咸其脢，无悔。
lines.6: 咸其輔，頰，舌。

original_text.tuan: 咸，感也。柔上而剛下，二氣感應以相與，止而說，男下女，是以亨利貞，取女吉也。天地感而萬物化生，聖人感人心而天下和平；觀其所感，而天地萬物之情可見矣！
image_lines: 咸其股，亦不處也。志在隨人，所執下也。
貞吉悔亡，未感害也。憧憧往來，未光大也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên núi có đầm, hai bên cảm ứng nhau; để lòng trống mà đón người.
interpretation.modern_summary: Sự đồng cảm thật đang mở ra; mở lòng, lắng nghe, đừng cố điều khiển cảm xúc của người khác.

legge.judgment: Hsien indicates that, (on the fulfilment of the conditions implied in it), there will be free course and success. Its advantageousness will depend on the being firm and correct, (as) in marrying a young lady. There will be good fortune.

lines.1: The first line, divided, shows one moving his great toes.
lines.2: The second line, divided, shows one moving the calves of his leg. There will be evil. If he abide (quiet in his place), there will be good fortune.
lines.3: The third line, undivided, shows one moving his thighs, and keeping close hold of those whom he follows. Going forward (in this way) will cause regret.
lines.4: The fourth line, undivided, shows that firm correctness which will lead to good fortune, and prevent all occasion for repentance. If its subject be unsettled in his movements, (only) his friends will follow his purpose.
lines.5: The fifth line, undivided, shows one moving the flesh along the spine above the heart. There will be no occasion for repentance.
lines.6: The sixth line, divided, shows one moving his jaws and tongue.

original_text.judgment: 恆：亨，无咎。利貞，利有攸往。
original_text.image: 雷風，恆；君子以立不易方。

lines.2: 悔亡。
lines.3: 不恆其德，或承之羞，貞吝。
lines.4: 田无禽。
lines.5: 恆其德，貞，婦人吉，夫子凶。
lines.6: 震恆，凶。

original_text.tuan: 恆，久也。剛上而柔下，雷風相與，巽而動，剛柔皆應，恆。恆亨无咎，利貞；久于其道也，天地之道，恆久而不已也。利有攸往，終則有始也。日月得天，而能久照，四時變化，而能久成，聖人久于其道，而天下化成；觀其所恆，而天地萬物之情可見矣！
image_lines: 婦人貞吉，從一而終也。夫子制義，從婦凶也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm và gió đi cùng nhau — bền lâu; đứng vững, không đổi hướng.
interpretation.modern_summary: Thói quen bền bỉ thắng cảm hứng nhất thời; chọn một hướng và giữ lấy nó.

legge.judgment: Hăng indicates successful progress and no error (in what it denotes). But the advantage will come from being firm and correct; and movement in any direction whatever will be advantageous.

original_text.image: 天下有山，遯；君子以遠小人，不惡而嚴。

lines.2: 執之用黃牛之革，莫之勝說。
lines.3: 係遯，有疾厲，畜臣妾吉。
lines.4: 好遯君子吉，小人否。
lines.5: 嘉遯，貞吉。
lines.6: 肥遯，无不利。

original_text.tuan: 遯亨，遯而亨也。剛當位而應，與時行也。小利貞，浸而長也。遯之時義大矣哉！
image_lines: 係遯之厲，有疾憊也。畜臣妾吉，不可大事也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Dưới trời có núi — lui ẩn; người quân tử xa kẻ tiểu nhân, không ghét bỏ mà nghiêm trang.
interpretation.modern_summary: Rút lui đúng lúc là khôn ngoan, không phải thua; giữ khoảng cách với điều làm hao tổn bạn.

original_text.image: 雷在天上，大壯；君子以非禮弗履。

lines.2: 貞吉。
lines.3: 小人用壯，君子用罔，貞厲。羝羊觸藩，羸其角。
lines.4: 貞吉悔亡，藩決不羸，壯于大轝之腹。
lines.5: 喪羊于易，无悔。
lines.6: 羝羊觸藩，不能退，不能遂，无攸利，艱則吉。

original_text.tuan: 大壯，大者壯也。剛以動，故壯。大壯利貞；大者正也。正大而天地之情可見矣！
image_lines: 不能退，不能遂，不詳也。艱則吉，咎不長也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm ở trên trời — mạnh lớn; lợi về giữ chính, điều không hợp lễ thì không làm.
interpretation.modern_summary: Sức mạnh đang lên; dùng nó có chừng mực, đừng như dê đực húc rào mà mắc sừng.

original_text.judgment: 康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接。
original_text.image: 明出地上，晉；君子以自昭明德。

lines.1: 晉如，摧如，貞吉。罔孚，裕无咎。
lines.2: 晉如，愁如，貞吉。受茲介福，于其王母。
lines.3: 眾允，悔亡。
lines.4: 晉如鼫鼠，貞厲。
lines.5: 悔亡，矢得勿恤，往吉无不利。
lines.6: 晉其角，維用伐邑，厲吉无咎，貞吝。

original_text.tuan: 晉，進也。明出地上，順而麗乎大明，柔進而上行。是以康侯用錫馬蕃庶，晝日三接也。
image_lines: 晉如，摧如；獨行正也。裕无咎；未受命也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Mặt trời mọc trên mặt đất — tiến lên; tự làm sáng cái đức sáng của mình.
interpretation.modern_summary: Thời tiến lên và được ghi nhận; làm tốt, rõ ràng và chia sẻ thành quả.

original_text.image: 明入地中，明夷；君子以蒞眾，用晦而明。

lines.1: 明夷于飛，垂其翼。君子于行，三日不食，有攸往，主人有言。
lines.2: 明夷，夷于左股，用拯馬壯，吉。
lines.3: 明夷于南狩，得其大首，不可疾貞。
lines.4: 入于左腹，獲明夷之心，于出門庭。
lines.5: 箕子之明夷，利貞。
lines.6: 不明晦，初登于天，後入于地。

original_text.tuan: 明入地中，明夷。內文明而外柔順，以蒙大難，文王以之。利艱貞，晦其明也，內難而能正其志，箕子以之。
image_lines: 初登于天，照四國也。後入于地，失則也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Ánh sáng vào trong đất, bị tổn thương; gian nan mà vẫn giữ chính, che bớt ánh sáng mà trong vẫn sáng.
interpretation.modern_summary: Hoàn cảnh không thuận để tỏa sáng; giữ ngọn lửa bên trong, kín đáo và kiên nhẫn.

original_text.image: 風自火出，家人；君子以言有物，而行有恆。

lines.2: 无攸遂，在中饋，貞吉。
lines.3: 家人嗃嗃，悔厲吉；婦子嘻嘻，終吝。
lines.4: 富家，大吉。
lines.5: 王假有家，勿恤。吉。
lines.6: 有孚威如，終吉。

original_text.tuan: 家人，女正位乎內，男正位乎外，男女正，天地之大義也。家人有嚴君焉，父母之謂也。父父，子子，兄兄，弟弟，夫夫，婦婦，而家道正；正家而天下定矣。
image_lines: 家人嗃嗃，未失也；婦子嘻嘻，失家節也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Gió từ lửa mà ra — người nhà; lời nói có thực, việc làm có thường, mỗi người đúng vị.
interpretation.modern_summary: Chăm vun gốc rễ: gia đình, nhóm thân; vai trò rõ ràng và lời nói đi đôi với việc làm.

original_text.image: 上火下澤，睽；君子以同而異。

lines.1: 悔亡，喪馬勿逐，自復；見惡人无咎。
lines.2: 遇主于巷，无咎。
lines.3: 見輿曳，其牛𧤊，其人天且劓，无初有終。
lines.4: 睽孤，遇元夫，交孚，厲无咎。
lines.5: 悔亡，厥宗噬膚，往何咎。
lines.6: 睽孤， 見豕負涂，載鬼一車， 先張之弧，後說之弧，匪寇婚媾，往遇雨則吉。

original_text.tuan: 睽，火動而上，澤動而下；二女同居，其志不同行；說而麗乎明，柔進而上行，得中而應乎剛；是以小事吉。天地睽，而其事同也；男女睽，而其志通也；萬物睽，而其事類也；睽之時用大矣哉！
image_lines: 見輿曳，位不當也。无初有終，遇剛也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Lửa trên đầm, hai bên trái lìa; việc nhỏ thì tốt, trong khác biệt vẫn tìm chỗ giống.
interpretation.modern_summary: Có bất đồng; đừng ép mọi người giống nhau, tìm một điểm chung nhỏ để cùng làm.

original_text.judgment: 利西南，不利東北；利見大人，貞吉。
original_text.image: 山上有水，蹇；君子以反身修德。

lines.2: 王臣蹇蹇，匪躬之故。
lines.3: 往蹇來反。
lines.4: 往蹇來連。
lines.5: 大蹇朋來。
lines.6: 往蹇來碩，吉；利見大人。

original_text.tuan: 蹇，難也，險在前也。見險而能止，知矣哉！蹇利西南，往得中也；不利東北，其道窮也。利見大人，往有功也。當位貞吉，以正邦也。蹇之時用大矣哉！
image_lines: 往蹇來碩，志在內也。利見大人，以從貴也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên núi có nước — đường gian nan; gặp người lớn thì lợi, quay lại sửa mình.
interpretation.modern_summary: Gặp trở ngại thì xem lại chính mình và tìm người giúp, hơn là lao thẳng vào.

original_text.judgment: 利西南，无所往，其來復吉。有攸往，夙吉。
original_text.image: 雷雨作，解；君子以赦過宥罪。

lines.2: 田獲三狐，得黃矢，貞吉。
lines.3: 負且乘，致寇至，貞吝。
lines.4: 解而拇，朋至斯孚。
lines.5: 君子惟有解，吉；有孚于小人。
lines.6: 公用射隼，于高墉之上，獲之，无不利。

original_text.tuan: 解，險以動，動而免乎險，解。解利西南，往得眾也。其來復吉，乃得中也。有攸往夙吉，往有功也。天地解，而雷雨作，雷雨作，而百果草木皆甲坼，解之時義大矣哉！
image_lines: 負且乘，亦可丑也，自我致戎，又誰咎也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm mưa nổi lên mà giải tỏa; tha lỗi, xá tội; việc xong thì về sớm.
interpretation.modern_summary: Căng thẳng đang được tháo gỡ; xử lý nhanh việc còn lại, tha thứ và nhẹ nhàng bước tiếp.

original_text.judgment: 有孚，元吉。无咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用？二簋可用享。
original_text.image: 山下有澤，損；君子以懲忿窒欲。

lines.2: 利貞，征凶，弗損益之。
lines.3: 三人行，則損一人；一人行，則得其友。
lines.4: 損其疾，使遄有喜，无咎。
lines.5: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，元吉。
lines.6: 弗損益之，无咎，貞吉，利有攸往，得臣无家。

original_text.tuan: 損，損下益上，其道上行。損而有孚，元吉，无咎，可貞，利有攸往。曷之用？二簋可用享；二簋應有時。損剛益柔有時，損益盈虛，與時偕行。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Dưới núi có đầm — bớt; có lòng tin thì cát, hai bát lễ đơn sơ cũng đủ.
interpretation.modern_summary: Lúc giản lược: bớt cái thừa, kiềm cơn giận và ham muốn; ít mà thật lòng là đủ.

original_text.image: 風雷，益；君子以見善則遷，有過則改。

lines.2: 或益之，十朋之龜弗克違，永貞吉。王用享于帝，吉。
lines.3: 益之用凶事，无咎。有孚中行，告公用圭。
lines.4: 中行，告公從。利用為依遷國。
lines.5: 有孚惠心，勿問元吉。有孚惠我德。
lines.6: 莫益之，或擊之，立心勿恆，凶。

original_text.tuan: 益，損上益下，民說无疆，自上下下，其道大光。利有攸往，中正有慶。利涉大川，木道乃行。益動而巽，日進无疆。天施地生，其益无方。凡益之道，與時偕行。
image_lines: 有孚惠心，勿問之矣。惠我德，大得志也。
莫益之，偏辭也。或擊之，自外來也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Gió và sấm giúp nhau — thêm; thấy điều thiện thì theo, có lỗi thì sửa.
interpretation.modern_summary: Thời được tiếp sức; dùng nó để giúp người và cải thiện mình, làm ngay khi còn thuận.

original_text.judgment: 揚于王庭，孚號，有厲，告自邑，不利即戎，利有攸往。
original_text.image: 澤上于天，夬；君子以施祿及下，居德則忌。

lines.2: 惕號，莫夜有戎，勿恤。
lines.3: 壯于頄，有凶。君子夬夬，獨行遇雨，若濡有慍，无咎。
lines.4: 臀无膚，其行次且。牽羊悔亡，聞言不信。
lines.5: 莧陸夬夬，中行无咎。
lines.6: 无號，終有凶。

original_text.tuan: 夬，決也，剛決柔也。健而說，決而和，揚于王庭，柔乘五剛也。孚號有厲，其危乃光也。告自邑，不利即戎，所尚乃窮也。利有攸往，剛長乃終也。
image_lines: 其行次且，位不當也。聞言不信，聰不明也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đầm dâng lên trời — quyết; tuyên rõ giữa triều đình, có lòng tin mà cảnh giác, không dùng vũ lực.
interpretation.modern_summary: Đến lúc dứt khoát với điều sai; nói rõ, minh bạch, nhưng không hằn học.

original_text.image: 天下有風，姤；后以施命誥四方。

lines.1: 系于金柅，貞吉，有攸往，見凶，羸豕，孚，蹢躅。
lines.2: 包有魚，无咎，不利賓。
lines.3: 臀无膚，其行次且，厲，无大咎。
lines.4: 包无魚，起凶。
lines.5: 以杞包瓜，含章，有隕自天。
lines.6: 姤其角，吝，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 姤，遇也，柔遇剛也。勿用取女，不可與長也。天地相遇，品物咸章也。剛遇中正，天下大行也。姤之時義大矣哉！
image_lines: 九五含章，中正也。有隕自天，志不舍命也。

interpretation.core_theme: Coming to meet; a new influence
interpretation.traditional_meaning: Dưới trời có gió — gặp gỡ; một hào âm gặp năm hào dương: sức nhỏ đang lớn, chớ coi thường.
interpretation.modern_summary: Một ảnh hưởng mới vừa xuất hiện; đánh giá tỉnh táo trước khi để nó lớn trong đời bạn.

original_text.judgment: 王假有廟，利見大人，亨。利貞。用大牲吉，利有攸往。
original_text.image: 澤上于地，萃；君子以除戎器，戒不虞。

lines.1: 有孚不終，乃亂乃萃，若號一握為笑，勿恤，往无咎。
lines.2: 引吉，无咎，孚乃利用禴。
lines.3: 萃如，嗟如，无攸利，往无咎，小吝。
lines.4: 大吉，无咎。
lines.5: 萃有位，无咎。匪孚，元永貞，悔亡。
lines.6: 齎資涕洟，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 萃，聚也；順以說，剛中而應，故聚也。王假有廟，致孝享也。利見大人亨，聚以正也。用大牲吉，利有攸往，順天命也。觀其所聚，而天地萬物之情可見矣。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đầm ở trên đất — tụ họp; vua đến miếu, dùng lễ lớn, sửa sang khí giới phòng điều bất ngờ.
interpretation.modern_summary: Mọi người đang quy tụ; cần một trung tâm giá trị chung và sự chuẩn bị cho điều ngoài dự tính.

original_text.judgment: 元亨，用見大人，勿恤，南征吉。
original_text.image: 地中生木，升；君子以順德，積小以高大。

lines.2: 孚乃利用禴，无咎。
lines.3: 升虛邑。
lines.4: 王用享于岐山，吉无咎。
lines.5: 貞吉，升階。
lines.6: 冥升，利于不息之貞。

original_text.tuan: 柔以時升，巽而順，剛中而應，是以大亨。用見大人，勿恤；有慶也。南征吉，志行也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trong đất mọc cây — lên dần; thuận đức, tích cái nhỏ thành cao lớn.
interpretation.modern_summary: Tiến bộ vững từng chút; cứ chăm chỉ đi lên và tìm người có kinh nghiệm chỉ dẫn.

original_text.judgment: 亨，貞大人吉，无咎，有言不信。
original_text.image: 澤无水，困；君子以致命遂志。

lines.1: 臀困于株木，入于幽谷，三歲不覿。
lines.2: 困于酒食，朱紱方來，利用亨祀，征凶，无咎。
lines.3: 困于石，據于蒺蔾，入于其宮，不見其妻，凶。
lines.4: 來荼荼，困于金轝，吝，有終。
lines.5: 劓刖，困于赤紱，乃徐有說，利用祭祀。
lines.6: 困于葛藟，于臲卼，曰動悔。有悔，征吉。

original_text.tuan: 困，剛掩也。險以說，困而不失其所，亨；其唯君子乎？ 貞大人吉，以剛中也。有言不信，尚口乃窮也。
image_lines: 據于蒺藜，乘剛也。入于其宮，不見其妻，不祥也。
來徐徐，志在下也。雖不當位，有與也。
劓刖，志未得也。乃徐有說，以中直也。利用祭祀，受福也。
困于葛藟，未當也。動悔，有悔，吉行也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Đầm không có nước — khốn; người quân tử dốc thân để giữ chí, lời nói khó được tin.
interpretation.modern_summary: Bị bó buộc và kiệt sức; giữ chí, nói ít, để việc làm thay lời giải thích.

original_text.judgment: 改邑不改井，无喪无得，往來井井。汔至亦未繘井。羸其瓶，凶。
original_text.image: 木上有水，井；君子以勞民勸相。

lines.2: 井谷射鮒，瓮敝漏。
lines.3: 井渫不食，為我心惻，可用汲，王明，並受其福。
lines.4: 井甃，无咎。
lines.5: 井冽，寒泉食。
lines.6: 井收勿幕，有孚元吉。

original_text.tuan: 巽乎水而上水，井；井養而不窮也。改邑不改井，乃以剛中也。汔至亦未繘井，未有功也。羸其瓶，是以凶也。
image_lines: 井泥不食，下也。舊井无禽，時舍也。
井渫不食，行惻也。求王明，受福也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên cây có nước — cái giếng; đổi làng không đổi giếng, khuyên dân giúp đỡ nhau.
interpretation.modern_summary: Quay về nguồn: giá trị cốt lõi, kỹ năng nền; giữ cho "giếng" của bạn sạch và dùng được.

original_text.judgment: 已日乃孚，元亨。利貞。悔亡。
original_text.image: 澤中有火，革；君子以治歷明時。

lines.2: 已日乃革之，征吉，无咎。
lines.3: 征凶，貞厲，革言三就，有孚。
lines.4: 悔亡，有孚改命，吉。
lines.5: 大人虎變，未占有孚。
lines.6: 君子豹變，小人革面，征凶，居貞吉。

original_text.tuan: 革，水火相息，二女同居，其志不相得，曰革。已日乃孚；革而信也。文明以說，大亨以正，革而當，其悔乃亡。天地革而四時成，湯武革命，順乎天而應乎人，革之時義大矣哉！
image_lines: 鞏用黃牛，不可以有為也。
君子豹變，其文蔚也。小人革面，順以從君也。

interpretation.core_theme: Change when the time is ripe
interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trong đầm có lửa — đổi thay; đến ngày đã chín mới được tin, sửa lịch cho rõ thời.
interpretation.modern_summary: Thay đổi lớn đến khi thời đã chín; chuẩn bị kỹ, giải thích rõ, rồi đổi dứt khoát.

original_text.image: 木上有火，鼎；君子以正位凝命。

lines.1: 鼎顛趾，利出否，得妾以其子，无咎。
lines.2: 鼎有實，我仇有疾，不我能即，吉。
lines.3: 鼎耳革，其行塞，雉膏不食，方雨虧悔，終吉。
lines.4: 鼎折足，覆公餗，其刑渥，凶。
lines.5: 鼎黃耳金鉉，利貞。
lines.6: 鼎玉鉉，大吉，无不利。

original_text.tuan: 鼎，象也。以木巽火，亨飪也。聖人亨以享上帝，而大亨以養聖賢。巽而耳目聰明，柔進而上行，得中而應乎剛，是以元亨。
image_lines: 鼎顛趾，未悖也。利出否，以從貴也。
鼎有實，慎所之也。我仇有疾，終无尤也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên cây có lửa — cái vạc; ngay ngắn ở vị trí để thành mệnh, nuôi người hiền.
interpretation.modern_summary: Biến điều thô thành giá trị; trau dồi bản thân và dùng tài năng cho điều lớn hơn mình.

original_text.judgment: 亨。震來虩虩，笑言啞啞。震驚百里，不喪匕鬯。
original_text.image: 洊雷，震；君子以恐懼修省。

lines.1: 震來虩虩，後笑言啞啞，吉。
lines.2: 震來厲，億喪貝，躋于九陵，勿逐，七日得。
lines.3: 震蘇蘇，震行无眚。
lines.4: 震遂泥。
lines.5: 震往來厲，億无喪，有事。
lines.6: 震索索，視矍矍，征凶。震不于其躬，于其鄰，无咎。婚媾有言。

original_text.tuan: 震，亨。震來虩虩，恐致福也。笑言啞啞，後有則也。震驚百里，驚遠而懼邇也。出可以守宗廟社稷，以為祭主也。
image_lines: 震來虩虩，恐致福也。笑言啞啞，後有則也。
震往來厲，危行也。其事在中，大无喪也。
震索索，中未得也。雖凶无咎，畏鄰戒也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm dồn dập — chấn động; sợ hãi mà tự xét mình, rồi cười nói vui vẻ.
interpretation.modern_summary: Một cú sốc đến; để nó đánh thức bạn, xem lại mình, rồi bình tâm tiếp tục.

original_text.judgment: 艮其背，不獲其身，行其庭，不見其人，无咎。
original_text.image: 兼山，艮；君子以思不出其位。

lines.2: 艮其腓，不拯其隨，其心不快。
lines.3: 艮其限，裂其夤，厲閽心。
lines.4: 艮其身，无咎。
lines.5: 艮其輔，言有孚，悔亡。
lines.6: 敦艮，吉。

original_text.tuan: 艮，止也。時止則止，時行則行，動靜不失其時，其道光明。艮其止，止其所也。上下敵應，不相與也。是以不獲其身，行其庭不見其人，无咎也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Núi chồng lên núi — dừng; nghĩ không vượt ra khỏi vị trí của mình.
interpretation.modern_summary: Dừng lại đúng lúc; tĩnh lặng thân và ý, chỉ làm việc của mình ở hiện tại.

original_text.image: 山上有木，漸；君子以居賢德，善俗。

lines.1: 鴻漸于干，小子厲，有言，无咎。
lines.2: 鴻漸于磐，飲食衎衎，吉。
lines.3: 鴻漸于陸，夫征不復，婦孕不育，凶；利禦寇。
lines.4: 鴻漸于木，或得其桷，无咎。
lines.5: 鴻漸于陵，婦三歲不孕，終莫之勝，吉。
lines.6: 鴻漸于陸，其羽可用為儀，吉。

original_text.tuan: 漸之進也，女歸吉也。進得位，往有功也。進以正，可以正邦也。其位剛，得中也。止而巽，動不窮也。
image_lines: 夫征不復，離群丑也。婦孕不育，失其道也。利用禦寇，順相保也。
其羽可用為儀，吉；不可亂也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên núi có cây — tiến dần; như người con gái về nhà chồng đúng lễ, cát, lợi về giữ chính.
interpretation.modern_summary: Tiến từng bước, đúng trình tự; như chim hồng đậu dần từ bến lên gò, vội vàng sẽ hỏng.

original_text.image: 澤上有雷，歸妹；君子以永終知敝。

lines.2: 眇能視，利幽人之貞。
lines.3: 歸妹以須，反歸以娣。
lines.4: 歸妹愆期，遲歸有時。
lines.5: 帝乙歸妹，其君之袂，不如其娣之袂良，月幾望，吉。
lines.6: 女承筐无實，士刲羊无血，无攸利。

original_text.tuan: 歸妹，天地之大義也。天地不交，而萬物不興，歸妹人之終始也。說以動，所歸妹也。征凶，位不當也。无攸利，柔乘剛也。
image_lines: 歸妹以娣，以恆也。跛能履吉，相承也。
帝乙歸妹，不如其娣之袂良也。其位在中，以貴行也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên đầm có sấm — em gái về nhà chồng ở vị phụ; tiến lên thì hung, không có lợi.
interpretation.modern_summary: Bạn ở vị thế không chủ động; giữ phận, hiểu rõ giới hạn của mối quan hệ, nghĩ đến kết cục lâu dài.

original_text.image: 雷電皆至，豐；君子以折獄致刑。

lines.1: 遇其配主，雖旬无咎，往有尚。
lines.2: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，往得疑疾，有孚發若，吉。
lines.3: 豐其沛，日中見沬，折其右肱，无咎。
lines.4: 豐其蔀，日中見斗，遇其夷主，吉。
lines.5: 來章，有慶譽，吉。
lines.6: 豐其屋，蔀其家，窺其戶，闃其无人，三歲不觌，凶。

original_text.tuan: 豐，大也。明以動，故豐。王假之，尚大也。勿憂宜日中，宜照天下也。日中則昃，月盈則食，天地盈虛，與時消息，而況于人乎？況于鬼神乎？
image_lines: 豐其沛，不可大事也。折其右肱，終不可用也。
豐其蔀，位不當也。日中見斗，幽不明也。遇其夷主，吉；行也。
豐其屋，天際翔也。窺其戶，闃其无人，自藏也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Sấm chớp cùng đến — thịnh lớn; đừng lo, nên như mặt trời giữa trưa.
interpretation.modern_summary: Đỉnh cao đang đến; tận hưởng và quyết đoán, nhưng nhớ mặt trời giữa trưa rồi cũng xế.

original_text.image: 山上有火，旅；君子以明慎用刑，而不留獄。

lines.2: 旅即次，懷其資，得僮僕貞。
lines.3: 旅焚其次，喪其僮僕，貞厲。
lines.4: 旅于處，得其資斧，我心不快。
lines.5: 射雉一矢亡，終以譽命。
lines.6: 鳥焚其巢，旅人先笑後號咷。喪牛于易，凶。

original_text.tuan: 旅，小亨，柔得中乎外，而順乎剛，止而麗乎明，是以小亨，旅貞吉也。旅之時義大矣哉！
image_lines: 旅焚其次，亦以傷矣。以旅與下，其義喪也。
旅于處，未得位也。得其資斧，心未快也。
以旅在上，其義焚也。喪牛于易，終莫之聞也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên núi có lửa — lữ khách; việc nhỏ hanh thông, sáng suốt cẩn trọng, không giữ án lâu.
interpretation.modern_summary: Bạn đang ở nơi lạ hoặc một giai đoạn tạm thời; khiêm nhã, gọn nhẹ, đừng gây thù.

original_text.judgment: 小亨。利有攸往。利見大人。
original_text.image: 隨風，巽；君子以申命行事。

lines.2: 巽在牀下，用史巫紛若，吉无咎。
lines.3: 頻巽，吝。
lines.4: 悔亡，田獲三品。
lines.5: 貞吉悔亡，无不利。无初有終，先庚三日，後庚三日，吉。
lines.6: 巽在牀下，喪其資斧，貞凶。

original_text.tuan: 重巽以申命，剛巽乎中正而志行。柔皆順乎剛，是以小亨，利有攸往，利見大人。
image_lines: 進退，志疑也。利武人之貞，志治也。
巽在牀下，上窮也。喪其資斧，正乎凶也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Gió nối gió — thuận mà vào; việc nhỏ hanh thông, lợi có chỗ đi, lợi gặp người lớn.
interpretation.modern_summary: Ảnh hưởng bằng sự mềm mỏng, đều đặn như gió thấm; kiên trì nhẹ nhàng hiệu quả hơn ép buộc.

original_text.image: 麗澤，兌；君子以朋友講習。

lines.2: 孚兌，吉，悔亡。
lines.3: 來兌，凶。
lines.4: 商兌，未寧，介疾有喜。
lines.5: 孚于剝，有厲。
lines.6: 引兌。

original_text.tuan: 兌，說也。剛中而柔外，說以利貞，是以順乎天，而應乎人。說以先民，民忘其勞；說以犯難，民忘其死；說之大，民勸矣哉！

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Hai đầm nối nhau — vui; bạn bè cùng nhau giảng tập.
interpretation.modern_summary: Niềm vui chung và trò chuyện chân thành mở đường; học cùng bạn bè, nhưng tránh vui hời hợt.

original_text.judgment: 亨，王假有廟，利涉大川，利貞。
original_text.image: 風行水上，渙；先王以享于帝立廟。

lines.2: 渙奔其机，悔亡。
lines.3: 渙其躬，无悔。
lines.4: 渙其群，元吉。渙有丘，匪夷所思。
lines.5: 渙汗其大號，渙王居，无咎。
lines.6: 渙其血，去逖出，无咎。

original_text.tuan: 渙，亨。剛來而不窮，柔得位乎外而上同。王假有廟，王乃在中也。利涉大川，乘木有功也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Gió đi trên nước — tan ra; vua đến miếu, lợi qua sông lớn.
interpretation.modern_summary: Điều cứng nhắc đang tan; buông cái tôi và hiềm khích, tìm lại điều kết nối mọi người.

original_text.image: 澤上有水，節；君子以制數度，議德行。

lines.2: 不出門庭，凶。
lines.3: 不節若，則嗟若，无咎。
lines.4: 安節，亨。
lines.5: 甘節，吉；往有尚。
lines.6: 苦節，貞凶，悔亡。

original_text.tuan: 節，亨，剛柔分，而剛得中。苦節不可貞，其道窮也。說以行險，當位以節，中正以通。天地節而四時成，節以制度，不傷財，不害民。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên đầm có nước — tiết chế; tiết chế khắc khổ quá thì không bền.
interpretation.modern_summary: Đặt giới hạn hợp lý cho thời gian, tiền bạc, cảm xúc — nhưng đừng khắt khe đến mức tự làm khổ.

original_text.image: 澤上有風，中孚；君子以議獄緩死。

lines.2: 鳴鶴在陰，其子和之，我有好爵，吾與爾靡之。
lines.3: 得敵，或鼓或罷，或泣或歌。
lines.4: 月既望，馬匹亡，无咎。
lines.5: 有孚攣如，无咎。
lines.6: 翰音登于天，貞凶。

original_text.tuan: 中孚，柔在內而剛得中。說而巽，孚，乃化邦也。豚魚吉，信及豚魚也。利涉大川，乘木舟虛也。中孚以利貞，乃應乎天也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên đầm có gió — lòng tin ở bên trong; lòng thành cảm được cả heo cá, lợi qua sông lớn.
interpretation.modern_summary: Sự chân thành là sức mạnh lúc này; lắng nghe để hiểu người, lời nói đi từ lòng.

original_text.judgment: 亨。利貞。可小事，不可大事。飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉。
original_text.image: 山上有雷，小過；君子以行過乎恭，喪過乎哀，用過乎儉。

lines.2: 過其祖，遇其妣；不及其君，遇其臣；无咎。
lines.3: 弗過防之，從或戕之，凶。
lines.4: 无咎，弗過遇之。往厲必戒，勿用永貞。
lines.5: 密雲不雨，自我西郊，公弋取彼在穴。
lines.6: 弗遇過之，飛鳥離之，凶，是謂災眚。

original_text.tuan: 小過，小者過而亨也。過以利貞，與時行也。柔得中，是以小事吉也。剛失位而不中，是以不可大事也。有飛鳥之象焉，有飛鳥遺之音，不宜上宜下，大吉；上逆而下順也。
image_lines: 弗過遇之，位不當也。往厲必戒，終不可長也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Trên núi có sấm — cái nhỏ vượt; việc nhỏ được, việc lớn không; chim bay không nên lên cao.
interpretation.modern_summary: Làm tốt những việc nhỏ, giữ khiêm nhường; chưa phải lúc cho tham vọng lớn.

original_text.image: 水在火上，既濟；君子以思患而豫防之。

lines.2: 婦喪其茀，勿逐，七日得。
lines.3: 高宗伐鬼方，三年克之，小人勿用。
lines.4: 繻有衣袽，終日戒。
lines.5: 東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之禴祭，實受其福。
lines.6: 濡其首，厲。

original_text.tuan: 既濟，亨，小者亨也。利貞，剛柔正而位當也。初吉，柔得中也。終止則亂，其道窮也。
image_lines: 東鄰殺牛，不如西鄰之時也；實受其福，吉大來也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Nước ở trên lửa — đã xong; ban đầu tốt, cuối cùng loạn: nghĩ đến hoạn nạn mà phòng trước.
interpretation.modern_summary: Việc đã thành; đừng lơ là — giữ được khó hơn đạt được, hãy để ý những vết nứt nhỏ.

original_text.judgment: 亨。小狐汔濟，濡其尾，无攸利。
original_text.image: 火在水上，未濟；君子以慎辨物居方。

lines.2: 曳其輪，貞吉。
lines.3: 未濟，征凶，利涉大川。
lines.4: 貞吉，悔亡，震用伐鬼方，三年有賞于大國。
lines.5: 貞吉，无悔，君子之光，有孚，吉。
lines.6: 有孚于飲酒，无咎，濡其首，有孚失是。

original_text.tuan: 未濟，亨；柔得中也。小狐汔濟，未出中也。濡其尾，无攸利；不續終也。雖不當位，剛柔應也。

interpretation.traditional_meaning: Lửa ở trên nước — chưa xong; con cáo nhỏ gần qua sông thì ướt đuôi, cẩn trọng phân biệt mọi vật.
interpretation.modern_summary: Gần tới đích nhưng chưa tới; thận trọng ở chặng cuối, đặt mọi thứ vào đúng chỗ của nó.
